title: Tree Pairs for Algebraic Bieri-Strebel Groups
summary: We reintroduce a previously discovered method for constructing tree pair representations for Algebraic Bieri-Strebel groups, as well as demonstrate a class of higher order groups that cannot have a tree pair representation. In doing so, we demonstrate that there is no maximum degree such that for all polynomials of higher degree, the associated Algebraic Bieri Strebel group must have a tree-pair representation.
